notes: The page presents a geometric complement and a lemma on a translation stabilising a nonempty open part of an anabelian elementary variety, followed by a reduction to curves and an argument for the complete case. Twenty-five principal written lines/segments were read, including the partially overlapping start of the lower cancelled paragraph; all interlinear and seven marginal-note lines were read in addition. All four supplied C marks are resolved on their saved crops: la, xu, Cet, ne sert à rien ici. The literal Cet is retained despite its grammatical difficulty. No stop or colon is visible between connu and Cet, so no punctuation is supplied. The source mixes additive U+u with multiplicative xu and u=1; all three forms are retained. The field after sur is capital K while point notation elsewhere uses lowercase k. The restriction Y is full height on the baseline after the vertical bar; the comma following it is preserved. The inserted conditional belongs between that expression/comma and a 2-2g. The condition au moins si g neq 1 attaches by its curved leader after cas général, not after est absurde. The double thin rule is reproduced in TikZ and attached as a marginal annotation to the lemma; it is physically on the source’s left. The dark slanted marginal note is beside the Cela paragraph/start of the cancelled block, with no exact textual leader; the faint ne sert à rien ici note lies lower, beside the cancelled argument. The lower block opens with a two-sided double bracket and is cancelled by its oblique slash and accompanying marginal stroke; the cancellation and incomplete sentence run to the bottom edge. No closing bracket or completion is supplied. The slash in the I definition is visually diagonal; setminus is the first reading, with a minus alternative retained. Bold authorial 18 and thin lower-left foliation 36 are distinguished; H’s editorial page note is not manuscript text. One scoped topological/closure argument was checked mathematically; the fixed-point formula, the dévissage, and the full lemma are not claimed verified.

check_events.outcome: Checked the step U+u subset Y implies Y+u subset Y in the complete irreducible curve case, conditional on the stated embedding into the Jacobian. Its image Y is closed, U is dense in Y, and translation t_u is an ambient automorphism. Hence closure(t_u(U)) = t_u(closure(U)) = t_u(Y), while t_u(U) subset Y and closedness imply closure(t_u(U)) subset Y. Thus t_u(Y) subset Y. Both are irreducible curves of the same dimension, so the inclusion is equality. This check does not establish the fixed-point formula or the reduction to this case.
